messages:
alex: Handoff — I'm wrapping my shift, leaving notes below.

alex: SHIFT: 2024-03-15 17:00 UTC -> 2024-03-15 01:00 UTC
alex: Current incidents:
- INC-512 DB read latency spike (started 2024-03-15 16:10 UTC). P95 reads ~1.2s -> impacting /embed and /search routes.
- No other active incidents.

alex: Mitigations applied:
- Failed over read traffic to replica-2 at 16:22 UTC.
- Throttled embed route to 60rps per key (temporary) at 16:35 UTC.
- Restarted db-conn-pool on prod: ```kubectl rollout restart deployment/db-conn-pool -n prod```
- Rolled back r2026.03.15 -> r2026.03.12 for query-optimizer at 16:50 UTC.

alex: Current status: latency down to ~300ms p95 after failover + throttling. Error rate back to baseline.

alex: Open follow-ups / next steps for you:
1) sam — validate replica query plans and run pg_stat_activity sampling (I left commands in #eng-infra-runbooks).
2) jordan — schedule a canary for r2026.03.15 with heavier DB tracing, aim for rollback guard rails.
3) morgan — own postmortem and timeline (INC-512).

alex: Notes: logs show repeated slow SELECT on model_embeddings table with large index scan; suspect missing index or planner change. I collected EXPLAINs to /tmp/explain_inc512.tar.gz.

alex: No urgent customer escalations right now. Pager duty assigned to sam for next 2h.

alex: Ping me if anything gets worse, I'll be reachable via DM. :thumbsup:

sam: Got it. I'll start with replica query plans now, will paste findings.

sam: Quick Q — did we leave KV cache TTL at 24h or reduce during mitigation?

alex: KV cache TTL reduced to 1h at 16:40 UTC (to lower mem pressure).

jordan: I'll prep a canary with DB tracing and 10% traffic split to canary nodes. ETA 40m.

morgan: I'll create the INC-512 ticket with the timeline, assign to myself and add impact severity.

deploy-bot: Deployed r2026.03.12 -> prod @ 2024-03-15T16:50:10Z

alex: Added the relevant logs snippet:
```
2024-03-15T16:15:02Z ERROR db read  select ... duration=1.25s plan=Seq Scan on model_embeddings
2024-03-15T16:21:14Z WARN  replica lag 0.3s
```

sam: saw that. I'll check index stats and run ANALYZE.

jordan: If p95 goes above 800ms again, fallback plan B is to enable read-only cache patch and divert non-critical endpoints.

morgan: note for postmortem — determine whether query planner change was from pg upgrade or optimizer flags in r2026.03.15.

alex: All right handing off. Last check: dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/d/ops/db-latency?from=now-6h&to=now

sam: Acknowledged. Taking over. :ok_hand:
